text:
emma: Heads-up: surge of tiny-gpu pods getting Pending -> Evicted in ap-southeast1 since 11:01 UTC. Pattern: FailedAttachVolume -> then preempted. Packing density collapsing.
infra-bot: ALERT: GPU_ATTACH_FAILURES ap-southeast1 count=14 window=7m
rafi: Can we see events for one pod? `kubectl describe pod small-gpu-21 -n ai`
emma: event snippet:
```
Events:
  Normal  Scheduled           3m  default-scheduler  Assigned small-gpu-21 to node-ap-se-11
  Warning FailedAttachVolume 2m  attach-detacher    rpc timeout after 35s
  Warning  Failed            1m  kubelet            Evicted: Preemption by higher priority
```
oliver: Looks like CSI attach latency + strict anti-affinity causing the scheduler to scatter instead of waiting. If attach holds kubelet for 30-45s scheduler gives up and starts new binds -> fragmentation.
sre-oncall: Immediate options: (1) bump warm-pool +20% for ap-southeast1, (2) do a rolling restart of csi-plugin on subset of hosts, (3) relax `gpu:exclusive` required anti-affinity to preferred in a canary ns, (4) temporarily increase preemption grace to 90s. Which order?
emma: Start with warm-pool bump + CSI restart on canary nodes. Avoid affinity flips unless needed.
rafi: Quick PromQL to correlate: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(csi_attach_duration_seconds_bucket{region="ap-southeast1"}[5m])) by (le))` and `sum(rate(csi_attach_errors_total{region="ap-southeast1"}[5m]))`
oliver: Ran it: p99 attach ~110-140s in last 15m, errors climbing. Host egress on warm-pool shows qdisc drops 1-2% at same times. Could be noisy network/egress shaping.
sre-oncall: Executed warm-pool bump (12->15) and restarted csi-plugin on nodes ap-se-10/11/12 in a staggered window. Monitoring.
emma: After actions, pending count down ~50% in 8m and evictions drop. Canary still shows lower packing density because scheduler prefers spread due to required anti-affinity.
rafi: Suggest canary scheduler scoring change: prefer packing tiny-gpu pods when node has >=0.5 free GPU (+12 score). Deploy to ml-canary ns only to validate.
oliver: Long-term: RFC to increase CSI attach timeout to 120s, add packing-aware scheduling plugin, and tune autoscaler warm pool for APAC peak hours. I'll draft RFC.
infra-bot: INCIDENT INC-2024-857 created for ap-southeast1 attach surge
sre-oncall: Follow-ups: add alert `csi_attach_p99 > 45s for 5m` to page SRE, bake runbook step to rotate CSI controller if p99 exceeds threshold, add metric `gpu_packing_density{az}`.
emma: Thanks team. We'll keep warm pool elevated for 1h and run the scheduler canary for 30m. Postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
